core_obligations: Prove that a map alpha : P -> E|_W with P perfect on W supported on T intersect W lifts to a map beta : R -> E with R perfect on X supported on T such that P is a direct summand of R|_W in D(O_W) compatible with alpha and beta|_W
proof_roadmap: The induction principle for enlarging W reduces to an elementary distinguished square (W subset X, f : V -> X) with V affine.

Over V, the scheme lemmas produce a perfect Q supported on f^{-1}T with Q|_{W x_X V} isomorphic to (P plus P[1])|_{W x_X V}, and after replacing Q by Q tensor I the map to E|_{W x_X V} lifts to a map Q -> E|_V.
The glueing lemma combines the maps on W and V into a morphism a : R -> E on X whose restrictions are the given ones, and R is perfect and supported on T as desired.
difficulty_reason: H3: an induction-plus-descent argument where the two scheme-case lifting lemmas produce the pieces and the glueing lemma assembles them.
